item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1357] UI - label wrapping not done properly in charts
item.description: I see overlap in text when texts are more then around 15 characters. May be spacing in not enough. It should be wrapped or spaced out evenly.
item.summary: UI - label wrapping not done properly in charts

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: Attached one more screenshot exhibiting same issue with bar chart
Hi, Thanks for sharing issue and sorry for too late my response. I checked this issue I found overlap in text in bar chart and pie chart on 0.7.0 version. I'll fix and improve this.
Note that I checked on 0.8.0 in master branch. But I didn't find overlap in text in pie chart.

GitHub user soralee opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/2133

ZEPPELIN-1357[Umbrella] Text overlap in the MultiBarChart

      1. What is this PR for?
        If using the `multiChartBar`, it often occurs overlap in text. So, this PR is for preventing to overlap in text.

The below is the case what I updated.
1. The xLabel generally show all of the text without rotation (less than 30).
2. If the xLabel size is over than 30 and less than 80, the xLabel text are rotated as 90 degree and displayed.
3. If the xLabel size is over than 80, the xLabel text are disappeared, but the tooltip is displayed.

I have made improvements based on my thinking, so I would appreciate to give me your feedback.
And if merged this PR, I'll update the feature so that user can use `min` and `max` variables by user on web.

      1. What type of PR is it?
        [Bug Fix | Improvement ]
      1. What is the Jira issue?
  • [ZEPPELIN-1357; UI - label wrapping not done properly in charts](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN/ZEPPELIN-1357)
      1. How should this be tested?
        1. Run the paragraph for bank data in the `Basic Features (Spark)` notebook.
        2. Execute the following query.
        ```
        %sql
        select * from bank
        ```
        3. Use the pivot in the `Setting` toggle in the `MultiBarChart` such as the screenshots.

And here is my comment about your sayings and why I used the `rotate` and `hide`.
>IMO, if bar chart automatically calculate and show label without overlap without user parameter that would be optimal.

Right! At first, I had also wanted that bar chart can be automatically calculate and show label without overlap and user parameter. However, because the nvd3 don't have These functions (or I might miss it), in the easy way, many users are using rotation for avoid overlap.
But, if there is a large amount of data, this rotation way also has a limit to showing label without overlap, so I handled by hiding the label.
